neighbours.label: the words jury, juror(s) and verdict
fire: The lawyers picked a jury from a pool of local residents.
She served on a jury for three weeks last winter.
The foreman of the jury stood and read the decision aloud.
In many states a criminal defendant has a right to a jury trial.
Two jurors were dismissed after talking to a reporter.
The judge thanked the jurors and sent them home.
The court clerk read the verdict as the family wept.
Lawyers for the company will appeal the verdict next month.
quiet: The lawyers picked a hotel near the local courthouse.
She served as a court interpreter for three weeks last winter.
The clerk of the court stood and read the docket aloud.
In many states a criminal defendant has a right to a public defender.
Two witnesses were excused after talking to a reporter.
The judge thanked the bailiffs and sent them home.
The court clerk read the charges as the family wept.
Lawyers for the company will appeal the fine next month.
